facts.text: I want to brainstorm methods to evaluate within-subjects development for players transitioning from academy to elite level in team sports.
I have repeated measures strength tests done every half year.
My strength test measurements span four years before transitioning to elite and four years after transitioning to elite.
I have six measurements spread between before and after the transition.
I want to investigate development using an approach suitable for six measurements spread between before and after transition.
I want R code in a tidyverse style for an ANOVA analysis.
My data frame is called both_debuttest3_selecttest.
In my data frame, there are variables named name, strength, and months_from_transition.
I have extra variables in the data frame and I am asking whether I should remove those.
I am asking whether extra variables interfere with the chosen ANOVA method.
When I run aov_results <- aov(Strength ~ Time*Test + Error(name/Test), data = anovatest2), I get the error that contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels.

keyphrases: four years before and after transition
contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels

events.text: User runs an ANOVA model and receives the error about contrasts requiring factors with 2 or more levels.
